angularDiameterSource: Stellar radius 1.155 +0.014 −0.016 solar radii from Torres et al. 2008, ApJ 677, 1324 (2008). It is a radius from stellar characterisation, not an interferometric diameter; the angular diameter in the record is that radius at the Gaia distance.
distanceSource: Gaia EDR3 parallax 20.7694 +/- 0.0266 mas via SIMBAD (2020yCat.1350....0G): 48.15 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius: 1.155 +0.014 −0.016 solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius, from Torres et al. 2008 (ApJ 677, 1324 (2008); arXiv:0801.1841). GM from their stellar mass 1.119 solar masses times the JPL solar GM 132712440041.93938 km^3/s^2. presentationUp: no spin axis is measured, so the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Effective temperature 6065 ± 50 K from Torres, Winn & Holman 2008 (ApJ 677, 1324; https://arxiv.org/abs/0801.1841), Table 1, the radius source: the weighted mean of ten independent determinations.
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 209458 (pscomppars): spectral type G0 V, from del Burgo & Allende Prieto 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016MNRAS.463.1400D/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 209458 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.01 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 209458 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.23086, from Barstow et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017ApJ...834...50B/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 209458 (pscomppars): age 3.1 Gyr, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 209458 (pscomppars): rotation period 10.65 d, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
